rationale.conceptual: The paper uses a standard Metropolis algorithm for the XY model, but the non-regular fractal lattice (Sierpinski gasket) requires custom construction of nearest-neighbor lists and the helicity modulus involves a non-trivial second-derivative estimator from sampled Hamiltonian moments. This is an established, multi-part algorithm that needs careful implementation, fitting the '3' anchor: an established but non-trivial method needing careful implementation.
rationale.execution: The reproduction pipeline has three straightforward stages (lattice generation, Monte Carlo simulation, observable computation) with simple sequential dependencies. No external tooling beyond NumPy, and no complex data assembly. This aligns with '2-3 sequential steps, standard libraries only, straightforward I/O', leaning toward 2 due to the low number of distinct steps.
